axioms.name: Experimental.P03_04.actualPrincipalShiftedInertia
axioms.meaning: The positive index of M_r−tG_r equals the number of actual whitened principal eigenvalues above t, for every real threshold t.
dependencies: finite spectral theorem for shifted symmetric matrices
axioms.supports: Upstream eigenvalue-count identification; no interlacing inequality, reciprocal root comparison or Dodgson conclusion is assumed.

proved_prerequisite_aliases.meaning: Positive actual principal Gram for every injective index map.
